answers.5:
cat /srv/lab/net/lan-main.nmconnection
grep '^address1=' /srv/lab/net/lan-main.nmconnection | cut -d= -f2 | cut -d, -f1 > /tmp/ip.txt
grep '^address1=' /srv/lab/net/lan-main.nmconnection | cut -d, -f2 > /tmp/gw.txt
cat /tmp/ip.txt /tmp/gw.txt   # 192.0.2.10/24, 192.0.2.1
answers.8:
cat /srv/lab/net/ip-route.txt
awk '$1=="default" {print $3}' /srv/lab/net/ip-route.txt > /tmp/run_gw.txt
cat /tmp/run_gw.txt   # 192.0.2.254
# 프로필은 192.0.2.1(manual), 실제는 192.0.2.254(proto dhcp): 변경이 아직 적용되지 않았다. nmcli connection up 이 필요하다
